guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 打开官方 CZR 领取页面
guide.description: 打开 airdrop.czrex.com 域名下的 CZR 领取页面。Genesis 和 Quest 参与者都在这里领取。不要使用私信、评论或搜索广告中的领取链接；如果不确定网站是否可信，可阅读来源提供的空投安全指南。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Open the Official CZR Claim Page
guide.original_description: Go to the CZR claim page on the airdrop.czrex.com domain. Genesis and Quest participants both claim here. Ignore claim links sent through DMs, comments or search ads, and read our airdrop safety guide if you are unsure about a site.

guide.title: 查看你是否符合资格
guide.description: 将钱包地址粘贴到资格查询器中，点击检查（Check）。请使用 Genesis 活动或 Quest 计划期间连接的以太坊钱包。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Paste your wallet address into the eligibility checker and click “Check.” Use the Ethereum wallet you connected during the Genesis campaign or the Quest program.

guide.title: 准备支付领取手续费所需的 ETH
guide.description: 领取需要发起以太坊交易，因此以太坊主网钱包中需有少量 ETH 支付手续费。原文提供了在 Bybit 购买 ETH，或通过来源页面下方组件把其他链资金跨链、兑换到以太坊的选项。原文还包含组件宣传：支持 30 多条链，宣称路由快速、费用较低；点击立即跨链（Bridge now）打开组件，也可在新标签页打开。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Get ETH for the Claim Fee
guide.original_description: The claim is an Ethereum transaction, so you need a small amount of ETH on Ethereum mainnet for gas. You can buy ETH on Bybit , or bridge and swap funds from another chain to Ethereum with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 连接符合资格的钱包
guide.description: 点击连接钱包（Connect Wallet），在 MetaMask、Rabby 或其他以太坊钱包中确认连接。钱包连接后，页面会显示 CZR 获配数量。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Click “Connect Wallet” and approve the connection in MetaMask, Rabby or another Ethereum wallet. The page shows your CZR allocation once the wallet is connected.

guide.title: 领取 CZR
guide.description: 点击领取按钮，在钱包中确认交易；请在领取时间窗口于 2026 年 10 月 5 日关闭之前完成。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Click the claim button and confirm the transaction in your wallet before the window closes on October 5, 2026.

guide.title: 等待 10 月 11 日解锁
guide.description: 空投的 CZR 在 10 月 1 日上线后锁定 10 天。到 10 月 11 日之前，不能出售、交易、转账或提取这些 CZR。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Airdropped CZR stays locked for 10 days after the October 1 launch. Until October 11, you cannot sell, trade, transfer or withdraw it.

guide.title: 在 CZR Exchange 交易 CZR
guide.description: CZR/USDT 现货交易于 10 月 1 日在 CZR Exchange 开放。交易所的 CZR 充值和提现暂停至新加坡时间 10 月 11 日下午 1 点；期间交易本身仍然开放。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: CZR/USDT spot trading opens on CZR Exchange on October 1. CZR deposits and withdrawals on the exchange stay paused until October 11 at 1:00 PM Singapore time, while trading itself remains open.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。

sourcedDescription: The CZR Genesis Airdrop ran from September 21 to 30, 2026, and rewarded users who completed account, wallet and social tasks with campaign coins. Midway through, the team doubled the Genesis pool from 5 million to 10 million CZR and doubled coins on qualifying tasks. Users who earned points in the earlier CZR Quest program also receive CZR, tracked separately from the Genesis pool.
